examples: You closed a session by accident: reopen it from the recent list instead of starting over.
The computer restarted overnight: bring back every session that was running with one click.
how_to: Look in RECENTLY CLOSED SESSIONS on the home screen for sessions that ended.
Click one to reopen it; a claude session resumes its conversation.
After a reboot, tick the sessions you want back in the reopen offer and accept.
name: Recent sessions and reopen
summary: see your recently used sessions, and reopen the ones a reboot left behind.
where: Home screen, the RECENTLY CLOSED SESSIONS card.
After a restart of the computer, a reopen offer lists what was running.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
